snippet.title: SONIC RUSH RERUN - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sonic Rush Rerun is a fan reimagining of the Nintendo DS title “Sonic Rush”. The idea behind this remaster is to take the greatest strengths of the Sonic Rush trilogy (Rush, Rush Adventure, and Colors DS), cranking them up to 11, and bringing those strengths together to create the ultimate version of the original Sonic Rush game! We want to make a definitive version of Sonic Rush for PC with additional content and to fix the problems with the original game.

We are grateful for your support and can't wait to show you more!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
